svg.title: Episode 05: ticketDorm
svg.desc: ticketDorm, in: the leaky faucet of room B-214. A dorm maintenance request system, from report to repair. A layered Java Spring Boot service with JPA, built around SOLID principles. Art: a dripping faucet, a ticket moving from open to assigned to resolved, and a fixed stamp.

g.text: IN: THE LEAKY FAUCET OF B-214
report to repair. A layered Spring
